In the facts, O3 is still `kind: behaviour`, which tells plan.split it can ship alone, and nothing ties O3 to O4 and O5 (O4 needs O3, O5 needs O4, O3 needs only O1). The Intent itself says O3 breaks action.yml and knowledge-audit.yml unless they change in the same commit, and tests/test_audit.py (under O5) pins `PROMPTS = HERE / "prompts"`, which O3 deletes. So the facts still let O3 land in its own pull request with a red gate. Encode it in the facts: merge O3, O4 and O5 into one behaviour outcome, or make O3 `support` with O4 and O5 depending on it. Moving tests/test_audit.py into O3's touches would close the gate break.
